# AGENTS.md

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

`bc-harness` — Claude Code plugin (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, v0.4.0, MIT). Slash commands, subagents and bash scripts that take a project from idea to code: `init` chain, `/plan` pipeline, `/bugfix` pipeline, `/ai-context` upsert, and `scripts/ralph.sh` autonomous phase execution. The only executable code is bash (`scripts/*.sh`, 7 files); everything else is Markdown with YAML frontmatter. No package manager manifest exists at any level.

## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `scripts/test-ralph.sh` | Full `ralph.sh` suite; fake `claude`/`codex` binaries on PATH, zero network, zero tokens (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:5-6`) |
| `scripts/test-ralph.sh <case>` | Run one named case (e.g. `gate2-escopado`, `gate2-skip`, `prompt-sem-suite`) |
| `RALPH_BIN=/path/to/patched-ralph.sh scripts/test-ralph.sh <case>` | Point the suite at a patched copy to prove red before green (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:13-15`) |
| `scripts/check-shell.sh` | `bash -n` over all scripts + `shellcheck -x` when available (`scripts/check-shell.sh:8`) |
| `scripts/check-init-drift.sh` | 23 verbatim anchors across `commands/init/*.md` + `commands/init.md` |

- No build step. Scripts run in place.
- No coverage tool anywhere in the repo.
- No CI: `.github/` and `.gitlab-ci.yml` are absent. The 4 commands above are the whole gate and are run by hand before committing.
- Test suite is one self-contained file, `scripts/test-ralph.sh` (2290 lines), 74 named cases gated by `case_enabled` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:558`; first case `:565`, last case `prompt-sem-suite` `:2272`). No `tests/` directory.
- Assertions are hand-rolled: `assert_eq` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:29`), `assert_contains` (`:35`), `assert_not_contains`. Each case runs in a `mktemp -d` sandbox with `trap 'rm -rf' EXIT` (`:17-18`).
- Mock engines are injected on PATH and dispatched by `MOCK_SCENARIO` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:226`); `MOCK_STATE` and `MOCK_TEST_CMD` tune them. The mock writes progress to stderr and the verdict to stdout on purpose — that is the stream-splitting invariant under test.
- Scope cases 66-73 assert exact suite call counts via `state/test_calls` and exact argv per invocation via `test_args_line` (`scripts/test-ralph.sh:2169`); `gate2-skip` asserts the suite runs ONCE in a 3-phase run while gate 3 still runs 3 times (`:2200-2203`).

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

Detail: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

| Rule | Enforcement |
|---|---|
| Every script starts with `#!/usr/bin/env bash` | convention, all 7 `scripts/*.sh` |
| `set -euo pipefail` in the orchestrator | `scripts/ralph.sh:322` |
| Scripts must parse under `bash -n` | `scripts/check-shell.sh:16-25` (always runs) |
| Scripts should pass `shellcheck -x` | `scripts/check-shell.sh:28-39` (optional; missing shellcheck does not fail) |
| Shared `init:*` wording stays byte-identical across the chain files | `scripts/check-init-drift.sh:37-87` (23 verbatim anchors) |
| `.phases/` runtime state is never committed | `.gitignore:9` |
| Secrets never literal in a tracked file | `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` / `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE` read at runtime by `scripts/notify-telegram.sh` |

- No `.editorconfig`, ESLint, formatter config or pre-commit hooks exist.
- Language split is deliberate — preserve it: `scripts/*.sh` comments and log messages in Portuguese; `README.md` English, `README.pt-BR.md` Portuguese; `agents/*.md` and `commands/*.md` English.
- `commands/init/*.md` duplicate the interview, language, re-run and staleness rules **on purpose**: plugin commands run inside the developer's project where `@`-includes to the plugin root are unreachable. Change a rule → change all 4 chain files + `commands/init.md`, then re-run `scripts/check-init-drift.sh`.
- Thin routers, agents own the content: `commands/*.md` orchestrate, verify artifacts on disk and report; they never author SPEC/PLAN/docs.
- Subagents get least-privilege tool grants in frontmatter. `agents/ai-context-inspector.md` is read-only (Read, Glob, Grep, Bash); writer agents get Write/Edit.
- `ralph.sh` invariants: fresh self-contained session per phase and per correction cycle, zero human interaction, completion decided by the gates never by engine exit code, one commit per completed phase (`commit_phase`, `scripts/ralph.sh:4220`).
- 4-gate engine: gate 0 engine really finished (`gate0_engine_finished`, `scripts/ralph.sh:3422`); gate 1 session wrote code (`gate1_session_wrote`, `:3465` — a signal feeding the correction cause, not a verdict); gate 2 project suite run by ralph outside the agent session (`gate2_tests_pass`, `:3816-3926`); gate 3 independent read-only verifier counting **unique** TASK indices, protocol `TASK <n>: DONE|INCOMPLETE` where `INCOMPLETE` beats `DONE` at the same index (`gate3_independent_verify`, `:3974`; contract at `:163-165`).
- Gate 2 scope resolution, six rules in order, first match wins (`resolve_gate2_scope`, `scripts/ralph.sh:3753`): (1) `TEST_SCOPE_MODE=full` (`:3760`); (2) phase is FINAL (`:3765`); (3) `VERIFY_MODE=off` (`:3772`); (4) phase declares `Suite: completa` (`:3777`); (5) diff touches `CRITICAL_PATHS_RE` (`:3784`); (6) test targets exist and `scoped_test_cmd` returns non-empty → scoped (`:3808`); otherwise skip (`:3794-3798`).
- `scoped_test_cmd` is the fail-safe boundary (`scripts/ralph.sh:3690-3719`): returns EMPTY — caller falls back to the FULL suite, never to less — for compound commands containing `;`, `&&`, `||`, `|` (`:3694-3696`) and for unknown runners including go/cargo/make (`:3717`). Paths append positionally for sail|artisan|php|pest|phpunit|pytest|py.test|jest|vitest|bun|mocha|rspec|deno (`:3709`) and after `--` for composer|npm|pnpm|yarn (`:3713`).
- Phase diff drives scope: `phase_changed_files` = `git diff --name-only HEAD` + untracked, deduped (`scripts/ralph.sh:3654`); `phase_declared_tests` also harvests backtick-quoted test paths from the phase's own `Testes:` text so an already-committed target test still counts (`:3672`).
- `resolve_final_phase` (`scripts/ralph.sh:3725`) walks the manifest skipping `--from` and already-done phases; the LAST survivor is `FINAL_PHASE_FILE` and always gets the full suite. Run banner names that phase, or warns that NO full suite will run when nothing is pending (`:4722-4731`).
- Implementation prompt is the behavioral half of the scope rule: the engine is told to run only the current task's tests and explicitly forbidden from the full suite (`scripts/ralph.sh:2774-2776`), plus an anti-filler-test rule (`:2781-2794`).
- Gate 2 test-command ladder, first rule wins (`resolve_test_cmd`, `scripts/ralph.sh:2388-2436`): `--test-cmd` > `RALPH_TEST_CMD` > manifest detection (Sail → `composer test` → `artisan` → `npm test` → `pytest` → `go test` → `cargo test`) > loud warning + gate 2 skipped (`:236-247`).
- Green-verdict reuse is keyed on `tree_signature()|scope|cmd`, so a SCOPED green can never be reused as a FULL verdict (`scripts/ralph.sh:3846-3851`).
- Surgical repair is a fail-closed cheap fix between a red gate and a full correction cycle (`repair_classify`, `scripts/ralph.sh:4266`): never commits, never replaces a gate, bounded by `RALPH_REPAIR_MAX_FILES` / `RALPH_REPAIR_MAX_TASKS`, can self-abort with `REPAIR_ABORT`.
- A dead external service is its OWN verdict, neither green nor red (`gate2_infra_failure`, `scripts/ralph.sh:3561`): try `docker start` / `sail up -d` (`:3596`), retry the suite once per phase, else end the run with a `wip(phase-N)` commit and exit 3.
- `.phases/state.json` (atomic tmp+mv snapshot) and `.phases/events.jsonl` (append-only) are a declared PUBLIC contract (`scripts/ralph.sh:173-182`); `state_sync()` at `:659`, `state_event()` at `:900`; `scripts/ralph-watch.sh` is a pure reader. Changing a key is a breaking change.
- Observability never changes a verdict: panel, dashboard and notifications are a side-effect layer. `--serve` binds `python3 -m http.server` to `127.0.0.1` and serves ONE static file, `.phases/ui/index.html` (`scripts/ralph.sh:1904-1907`); python3 absent = loud warning, run continues.

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Report gate results as facts: which gate, which phase, which log under `.phases/logs/`. No optimistic summaries.
- Change a script → run `scripts/check-shell.sh` and `scripts/test-ralph.sh` in the same turn; a new behavior needs a new named case in `scripts/test-ralph.sh`, proven red first via `RALPH_BIN`.
- Edit any `init:*` shared rule → apply it verbatim to all 5 files and re-run `scripts/check-init-drift.sh`.

### Never in this repository

- Never hand-edit a file whose line 3 carries the `/ai-context` ownership banner (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/agents/*.md`) — regenerate via `/bc-harness:ai-context`.
- Never commit a script that fails `bash -n` (`scripts/check-shell.sh:16-25`).
- Never reword an `init:*` rule in a single file — `scripts/check-init-drift.sh` fails on the missing verbatim anchor.
- Never write `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` values into any tracked file; read them from env or the `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE`.
- Never commit `.phases/` (`.gitignore:9`) — it is regenerated runtime state.
- Never make `ralph.sh` prompt a human or decide completion from an engine exit code.
- Never let `scoped_test_cmd` guess a command for an unknown or compound runner — returning empty (full suite) is the required fail-safe (`scripts/ralph.sh:3694-3696`, `:3717`).
- Never plan or write a test merely to satisfy a gate; never append a "run the tests" phase to a plan (`agents/planner.md`, `commands/init/project-phases.md`).
- Never let a notification, panel or dashboard failure change a gate verdict or the exit code.

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: bash 4+ (arrays, `[[ ]]`, process substitution), git, coreutils/`awk`/`sed`/`grep`; optional `python3` (`--serve` dashboard, `sail-guard.sh:29` JSON fallback), `jq` (preferred JSON parser, `sail-guard.sh:26`), `curl` (Telegram, `notify-telegram.sh:131,151`), `docker` (environment recovery), `shellcheck` (lint).

Install the plugin:

```sh
/plugin install bc-harness
```

`ralph.sh` engine prerequisites — one of the two, plus its API key (`scripts/ralph.sh:317-319`):

```sh
npm install -g @openai/codex              # codex engine  + OPENAI_API_KEY
npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code  # claude engine + ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
```

Run the orchestrator from the root of a git repository with a **clean** working tree:

```sh
./ralph.sh [opcoes] [caminho-do-arquivo]
./ralph.sh --help
```

Exit codes (`scripts/ralph.sh:313-315`): `0` = all phases green, `1` = failure or abort, `3` = run ended by a dead environment.

Read-only live panel over `.phases/`, from a second terminal:

```sh
./ralph-watch.sh [--once|--interval N|--embedded|--no-color] [repo]
```

Local checks:

```sh
scripts/check-shell.sh
scripts/check-init-drift.sh
scripts/test-ralph.sh
```

| Symptom | Check |
|---|---|
| Aborts before phase 1 on a dirty tree | `ralph.sh` requires a clean repo; commit or stash |
| Engine not found | Install `codex` or `claude` and export the matching API key (`scripts/ralph.sh:317-319`) |
| Gate 2 skipped with a loud warning | No test command resolved; pass `--test-cmd "<cmd>"` or set `RALPH_TEST_CMD` (`scripts/ralph.sh:236-247`, `:2388-2436`) |
| Gate 2 ran only part of the suite | Scope is `auto` by default; force everything with `--full-suite`, `RALPH_TEST_SCOPE=full`, or the phase line `Suite: completa` (`scripts/ralph.sh:3753-3808`) |
| Full suite never runs in a resumed run | Nothing pending → no FINAL phase; the run banner warns about it (`scripts/ralph.sh:4722-4731`) |
| Preflight exits 1 on scope | `RALPH_TEST_SCOPE` accepts only `auto` or `full` (`scripts/ralph.sh:2521-2527`) |
| Run ends with exit 3 and a `wip(phase-N)` commit | Environment guard classified a dead external service; bring containers up and re-run (`scripts/ralph.sh:3558-3641`) |
| `--serve` prints no URL | `python3` missing; dashboard binds `127.0.0.1` only and serves `.phases/ui/index.html` (`scripts/ralph.sh:1904-1907`) |
| Telegram notifications silent | `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD` empty = off; validate with `scripts/notify-telegram.sh --setup` |
| Host `php`/`artisan`/`composer` command blocked | `scripts/sail-guard.sh` PreToolUse hook rewrote it to the Sail equivalent; exit 2 = blocked, stderr carries the replacement; fails open when neither `jq` nor `python3` exists |
| `--max-cycles` seems off by 2 | Help text at `scripts/ralph.sh:35` and `:269` says 3; the code sets `MAX_CYCLES="${RALPH_MAX_CYCLES:-5}"` (`:330`). Real default is 5 |
| Generated `docs/` and `CLAUDE.md` show as untracked | `.gitignore:12` ignores the bare path `docs`, `.gitignore:18` ignores `CLAUDE.md` — the repo cannot ship its own generated context tree; only `AGENTS.md` is tracked |
| README mentions `docs/plans/` | Directory does not exist; `docs/` contains only `agents/` (README.md:480 is stale) |

No `.env.example` exists — env var names come from script source. Gate/scope inputs: `RALPH_TEST_CMD`, `RALPH_TEST_SCOPE`, `RALPH_CRITICAL_PATHS`, `RALPH_TEST_FILE_RE`, `RALPH_VERIFY`, `RALPH_VERIFY_MODEL`, `RALPH_MODEL`, `RALPH_BASELINE`, `RALPH_MAX_CYCLES`. Repair: `RALPH_REPAIR`, `RALPH_MAX_REPAIRS`, `RALPH_REPAIR_MODEL`, `RALPH_REPAIR_MAX_FILES`, `RALPH_REPAIR_MAX_TASKS`. Environment guard: `RALPH_ENV_GUARD`, `RALPH_ENV_RECOVER_TIMEOUT`. Usage limits: `RALPH_MAX_LIMIT_WAITS`, `RALPH_LIMIT_WAIT_DEFAULT`, `RALPH_LIMIT_BUFFER`, `RALPH_WEEKLY_THRESHOLD`. UI/output: `RALPH_VERBOSE`, `RALPH_HEARTBEAT`, `RALPH_UI`, `RALPH_UI_FPS`, `RALPH_UI_KEYS`, `RALPH_SERVE_PORT`, `RALPH_ATTACH_INTERVAL`, `RALPH_CAVEMAN`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_CMD`. Exported to the engine session: `RALPH_ENGINE`, `RALPH_PROJECT`, `RALPH_PHASE_TITLE`, `RALPH_PHASE_NUM`, `RALPH_PHASE_TOTAL`, `RALPH_PHASE_ATTEMPT`, `RALPH_PHASE_MAX_ATTEMPTS`, `RALPH_PHASE_REPAIR`, `RALPH_EVENT`. Test-only: `RALPH_BIN`, `MOCK_SCENARIO`, `MOCK_STATE`, `MOCK_TEST_CMD`. Watch: `RALPH_WATCH_COLS`, `RALPH_WATCH_LINES`, `RALPH_LIB_ONLY`. Telegram adapter: `RALPH_NOTIFY_ENV_FILE`, `RALPH_NOTIFY_API_BASE`, `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN`, `TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID`. Engines: `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Plugin: `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT`.
